title: Complainant Under Influence Exception
description: Product manufacturer not liable if complainant under influence of alcohol or prescription drug

content.general_rule: Product manufacturer liable for failure to provide adequate warnings or instructions
content.exception: Product manufacturer not liable if complainant under influence of alcohol or prescription drug
conditions: complainant was under the influence of alcohol or any prescription drug which had not been prescribed by a medical practitioner
